component.name: Cosmic FX
Cosmic FX (Centro de Físicas y Efectos)
component.summary: Compiz Physics, Wobbly Windows & 3D Elastic Effects for Pop!_OS COSMIC
Físicas estilo Compiz, Ventanas Gelatinosas y Rebote Elástico 3D para COSMIC

description.p: Cosmic FX brings classic Compiz and modern macOS-inspired physics to Pop!_OS 24.04 COSMIC Desktop. Enjoy smooth wobbly windows, 3D card lift elevation, spring bounce animations for maximize/restore, open/close transitions, and liquid glass neon focus rings.

Cosmic FX incorpora físicas legendarias estilo Compiz y micro-interacciones modernas a Pop!_OS COSMIC Desktop. Disfruta de ventanas gelatinosas suaves, elevación tridimensional al arrastrar, rebotes elásticos al maximizar, animaciones fluidas de apertura/cierre y bisel de luz neón Liquid Glass.
